title: Refactor round 2 reviewed: build on it; the ceiling re-based to 6,000; four suites are red on the base itself; the Pearl seam is the next round's subject
context: Architecture review (Fable, per the architecture-review skill) of branch refactor-round-2 (d1726b58..c22d001a, nine commits, plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-13-refactor-round-2.md) against its base pearl-enemies 8bf59188. The round was planned and reviewed by Fable and executed by Opus and Sonnet subagents overnight on the owner's instruction (2026-10-13: 'devise a refactoring plan, implement'). git diff --stat: 25 files, +2,280/-487; src/td-tab.js 6,120 -> 5,839 lines (-281; +32 of them the laser arsenal's and station's literals one member per line, paid back by the four moves), 0 lines over 500 characters throughout; no other file over 1,000 lines changed. npm run architecture: 'Guard: src/td-tab.js: 5839 lines under its ceiling 6000' and '155 pure-layer modules checked; game/lab controller boundaries, the line ceiling, the long-line budget and top-level placement hold.' node test/host-contracts.mjs: 'Host contracts hold for 57 factories' (52 on the base; NESTED is empty, MISSING unchanged at sector-run's beep). npm test 259 programs (251 on the base), npm run check and npm run build green at c22d001a. New owners: src/domain/wave-clock.js (six controller lets as one state with named transitions, the frame keeping its order), src/platform/boot-probes.js, src/fx/brief-queue.js, src/fx/engine-audio.js, src/fx/hull-deploy.js; each with test/<module>.mjs of named assertions; tests added for colony-tick, ending-host and laser-station. Existing owners checked for each concept: the deploy maths stays in src/domain/deploy-path.js (the fx module calls it), the brief content in src/isaobriefs.js, the steer bank in src/domain/steer-ease.js; no parallel implementation. Every move was proven by running the original block text beside the module on the same seeded inputs (the wave clock 20,000 frames / 8,072 log entries equal; the probes 400 runs / 39,755 entries; the briefs 2,988,521 entries; the engine 281,524; the deploy 157,992; two mutants caught per move), by undef-diff, comments-kept and tdz-check, and by the browser suites from frozen snapshots: --sectors --round6 --round7 --pacing --waves --laser-game --laser --seats --finale --opening --chapters --opening-probe green after their tasks. The baseline battery on the untouched base (seventeen suites, scratch baseline/summary.log) is red at four: --defense ('no unpiloted tower kill'), --story ('twelve landmarks at stage 8', 15 found, 15 s in, so its later steps never run), --pearl-story ('no Pearl body jumps in a frame', intermittent per 2026-10-13-pearl-enemies-round-four), --probe (shell-explosion, after mobile-input passes); every one of them fails at the same step with the same values on the branch.
outcome: Build on it. The ceiling is re-based by decision from 6,400 to 6,000 (5,839 measured plus a round's slack; the plan said the printed count plus 150, rounded up to the hundred). Findings, most structural first, none repaired here: (1) The four base reds are the owner's to triage before this branch is judged by them: --defense and --story were green at the refactor run's review on 2026-10-07 and are red at 8bf59188 before this round touched anything; a bisect over the pearl-enemies commits is the next step (--story's 'twelve landmarks at stage 8' smells of the Pearl set's bodies or the feed inset counting as landmarks). (2) src/fx/creature-enemies.js (359 lines) is three subjects behind one factory: the creature probe (its ground, garrison, spawnProbe and card), the Pearl set in story mode (dress, thin, pearlState) and the hull-against-bodies contact (hullAt, contactSink, bodyContact, the settle pass, about 80 allocation-free lines over PEARL_IMPACT.contact), plus a `test` bag of about twenty-five harness-only members shipped inside the module; once the Pearl direction settles (hit points, full waves), the contact block wants src/fx/hull-contact.js, the harness bag its own module, and `thin` (a wave-balance rule over queue entries, pure) belongs in src/domain beside spreadPicks. (3) PEARL_SPECS and PEARL_BODIES are content-derived tables built in an fx module from ENEMY_SPEC and the content set; a domain or content owner would let labs and tests import them without three.js. (4) src/fx/engine-audio.js steps the hull's feel and bank inside the audio update, as the controller did; a presentation tick inside an audio module, named and left. (5) Three oddities the executors recorded, pre-existing and unchanged: updateEngine skips the feel step on frames with no mesh or a zero dt; the state probe's header says 24 s but it runs 140 s (a later comment explains it); deployStart on a hull not yet issued counts a deploy, zeroes the lever and stops the engine, then parks and returns true. (6) The move-proof tests of the 2026-10-07 round still pin sha digests (finding 2 of that review); no such module was changed on purpose this round, so none was converted. Nothing is merged or pushed; the owner test-runs the worktree /Users/minikai/Dev/stalheart-refactor-2 locally first.
alternatives: Keep the ceiling at 6,400: it would leave 561 lines of slack, more than a playtest round has ever added; the ceiling is meant to be felt.
Refactor the Pearl seam in this round: the owner's direction there is a day old and still moving (hit points, full waves, the shell order); a split now would be redone.
Bisect the base's four reds in this round: outside a behaviour-neutral refactor's scope, and the owner's machine is where --pearl-story's intermittency was measured.
